name: Ta Phin
summary: Village walk north of town: see the houses and terraces in daylight without a guide, the other short trip. An older loop runs from town through Ta Phin, Móng Sến, and Tắc Cô. A 2023 table prints Tả Phìn–Sín Chải–Hầu Thào at 40,000 đồng for an adult and 20,000 đồng for a child. Read the gate. The 2025 xã Tả Phìn merged Trung Chải with Tả Phìn.
getThere: North of town on the Ta Phin loop. Minutes are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: Houses, the path, and terraces at Ta Phin
body: Walk the houses, the path, and the terraces under the peak. Vietnam Tourism names Ta Phin with Cat Cat as a village you can see without a guide. An older route is town, Tả Phìn, Móng Sến, Tắc Cô, and back to town.

An older article places thôn Tả Phìn in xã Tả Van. The 2025 xã Tả Phìn is the merger of xã Trung Chải and xã Tả Phìn. Keep those two names apart when you ask the way. A 2023 CafeBiz table prints Tả Phìn–Sín Chải–Hầu Thào at 40,000 đồng for an adult and 20,000 đồng for a child. Read the gate.

gettingThere: Ta Phin is the walk north of town, the pair to Cat Cat on the Vietnam Tourism page. The older loop is town, Tả Phìn, Móng Sến, Tắc Cô, and back. A published distance and a minute count are missing.

legs.body: Take the Ta Phin loop north of town. A published minute count is missing, so ask before you start.
